body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Nyko(www.nyko.com) showed off 'WAND+', its new Nintendo Wii remote controller with built-in MotionPlus during Digital Experience event at CES 2010. According to the company, the Wand+ reduces the controller's overall size and delivers more comfortable total gaming experience. It is expected to be available in February 2010.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
